records.name: V A M Karthik

questions.general:
P1: Asked me about my background.
My role as a software developer there.
what I have done after my first job. (I'm currently working as an inspector central tax.)
He asked to explain the difference between IGST, CGST etc.
Who's benefiting from GST?
(I said win-win, tried to explain but was cut short) What's the rate of inflation.
(Retail inflation is upwards of 7%. I think 7.4%)
Has CGST effected inflation. (It's the other way round.. inflation has effected GST)
questions.mathStats:
P2: what do you want to be asked about in maths? (I said linear algebra, calculus..)
1. Suppose you have A 5X2 and B 2X5. What can you say about the rank of AB. Why?
Tried to explain.. he said I'm just applying a formula.. so i said we can take a variable matrix A, B and multiply them... Then convert it into Row Reduced form, I'm sure we'll get rank almost
2). P3 was specifically called on to ask "Engineering Questions".
P3: Is relaminarisation possible? ( I said its been a long time, I don't remember. He said these are basics, you should not forget) What's choking in a flow?
How does it impact the diameter of the nozzle?
What if I keep increasing the diameter? (I said as the diameter increases, pressure decreases and if the flow is too fast, there will be shocks)
What's an instantaneous flow? (No time lag between starting and the point in consideration)
How do you measure an instantaneous flow?
( I was trying to explain some method, he said it's differential calculus)
What is Euler's integral theorem?
(complex analysis.. explained from what I remembered. Forgot to use the word residue.)
What's the difference between Hessian and Jacobian?
(Explained that Hessian is used to get an idea about the maxima and minima while Jacobian is used while transforming coordinate axis)
Where do you use them?
If I say one of them contains first order partial derivatives of vector valued function what will it be?
(I said Jacobian. He asked if I'm sure, then I said both contains first order partial derivatives. Then he said one of them has partial derivatives of scalar valued function and one has partial derivatives of vector valued function)
In simulations, we use Euler's method 1, Kutta 2, Kutta 4.. what's the difference?
(I said these are used for numerical integration.. he said *that's not it*.. they have something to do with the time factor.)
After that, he said to other profs, we have asked him enough questions.. they agreed and they said I may leave.
